meta.name: Tom Andrieu
meta.title: Product Builder · Rethinking work with AI
meta.description: I build products, and I help people and companies rethink how they work with AI.

hero.title: HEY
hero.quote: I've been building products for 8 years, and I'm convinced AI is going to upend our relationship with work. Most companies use it to go a bit faster and keep everything else as is. I think we can start from scratch: rethink how we work, how we design things, how we live our days. That's what drives me now. Helping people get through this shift without getting lost.

about.intro: AI is a new kind of entity in our world. What drives me is helping people <highlight>find their place</highlight> next to it, and <highlight>rethink work</highlight> instead of just speeding it up.
about.detail: With Gabriel Desbouis, we're starting our own company. The idea: spend several days inside companies, small businesses and large groups alike, to understand how teams actually work. Then build custom tools with them, AI or not, and explain what AI is and how it works. The biggest blocker is the fear of getting lost. That's what we're here for. If companies come out ahead, great. But what drives me is rethinking our relationship with work, and doing my part for a slightly better world.

craft.title: AI POWERED
craft.description: AI made me stack-agnostic. Language, framework or platform: I pick what fits the problem, not what I already knew.
